cases.title: Baseline single turn
cases.input: Give a short in-character greeting.
setup: Start a fresh one-on-one chat.
Use default prompt settings and no extra lorebooks.
expectedSignals: Final payload contains one new user turn.
No activated world info entries.
cases.notes: Control case for message ordering and empty WI state.

cases.title: Baseline multi turn
cases.input: Respond to the latest question without summarizing prior turns.
setup: Use a regular private chat with default prompt settings.

chatSeed.content: How are you settling into town?
I am still learning who lives on each street.
What has surprised you most so far?

expectedSignals: History ordering is preserved.
No hidden turns are omitted because none exist.
cases.notes: Checks ordinary multi-turn assembly.

cases.title: Empty send fallback
setup: Enable the normal send-if-empty behavior.
Use a chat whose latest visible turn is assistant.

chatSeed.content: I am waiting for your next instruction.

expectedSignals: A fallback user message is inserted before dispatch.
No WI activation depends on user input.
cases.notes: Useful for comparing send_if_empty handling.

cases.title: Continue generation
setup: Use continue mode in a normal chat.
Leave continue prompt defaults unchanged.

chatSeed.content: The map was folded into four precise quarters, and on its back someone had written

expectedSignals: Continue nudge appears instead of a normal user turn.
Dispatch payload reflects continue-specific shaping.
cases.notes: Compare continue-mode prompt shaping and prefill behavior.

cases.title: Quiet generation
cases.input: Summarize the current situation in one sentence.
setup: Use quiet generation from an existing chat.

chatSeed.content: We reached the observatory after dusk.
The lens chamber was still warm.

expectedSignals: Quiet prompt enters control prompts.
Streaming may be disabled depending on provider.
cases.notes: Compare quiet-specific system shaping.

cases.title: Impersonate generation
cases.input: Describe what you do next.
setup: Use impersonate mode in a private chat.
Keep default impersonation prompt enabled.

chatSeed.content: The courtyard is empty except for a fountain.

expectedSignals: Impersonation control prompt appears.
User perspective shaping differs from normal generation.
cases.notes: Compare impersonation prompt insertion and ordering.

cases.title: Persona description in prompt
cases.input: Reply as if you know my habits already.
setup: Enable persona description and place it in prompt.
Use a persona with a distinctive detail.
expectedSignals: Persona description is present in system prompt sections.
No duplicate persona text appears in chat history.
cases.notes: Compares persona placement rather than user-visible output.

cases.title: Scenario formatting
cases.input: Ask about the weather in this setting.
setup: Populate scenario text.
Use a non-default scenario format template.
expectedSignals: Scenario text is formatted once with the configured wrapper.
No stale scenario text remains from prior settings.
cases.notes: Useful when comparing custom formatting regressions.

cases.title: Personality formatting
cases.input: Answer in a way that reflects the character personality.
setup: Populate character personality text.
Use a non-default personality format.
expectedSignals: Personality text lands in its own system section.
Formatting matches the configured template.
cases.notes: Separates personality formatting from description handling.

cases.title: Persona position toggle
cases.input: Reference one of my stated preferences.
setup: Prepare a persona description with a distinctive preference.
Run once with persona in prompt and once with it elsewhere.
expectedSignals: Dispatch payload changes when persona position changes.
History messages should not absorb the persona text.
cases.notes: Intended as a same-branch toggle comparison case.

cases.title: Group chat nudge
cases.input: Only one character should answer this prompt.
setup: Use a group chat with at least three members.
Keep default group nudge enabled.
expectedSignals: Group chat prompt and group nudge are inserted.
Selected speaker behavior is visible in the payload.
cases.notes: Checks group-only control prompts and naming context.

cases.title: Completion names behavior
cases.input: Answer in character and preserve speaker names.
setup: Use a group chat.
Set names behavior to completion mode.

chatSeed.name: Kara
chatSeed.content: The lighthouse lamp was still burning.

expectedSignals: Assistant or system messages carry name fields where supported.
Name sanitization is consistent across branches.
cases.notes: Compare name field placement and sanitization.

cases.title: Dialogue examples after history
cases.input: Use the demonstrated style.
setup: Add example dialogue blocks.
Leave pin examples disabled.
expectedSignals: Example chat appears after normal chat history.
New example chat marker is present if budget allows.
cases.notes: Compares example ordering when examples are not pinned.

cases.title: Dialogue examples pinned
cases.input: Use the demonstrated style.
setup: Add example dialogue blocks.
Enable pin examples.
expectedSignals: Example chat appears before normal history.
Budget tradeoffs differ from the unpinned case.
cases.notes: Checks prompt ordering changes caused by pinning examples.

cases.title: Main prompt override
cases.input: Reply according to the override only.
setup: Configure a main prompt override with unmistakable text.
Keep the main prompt override allowed.
expectedSignals: The override replaces the normal main prompt content.
Overridden prompt metadata is recorded in assembly output.
cases.notes: Primary override parity case.

cases.title: Disabled jailbreak prompt
cases.input: Reply normally.
setup: Disable the jailbreak prompt for the active character.
Set a jailbreak override anyway.
expectedSignals: Disabled jailbreak prompt does not appear.
Override is ignored when forbids or disable state applies.
cases.notes: Compares disabled prompt handling against override code paths.

cases.title: Disabled system prompt
cases.input: Reply while the main system prompt is disabled.
setup: Disable a non-main prompt and a dynamic extension prompt.
Use a recognizable disabled prompt body.
expectedSignals: Disabled prompts do not survive into the final payload.
Remaining prompt ordering is stable.
cases.notes: Focuses on omission rather than override.

cases.title: Regex and extension prompt injection
cases.input: Mention the codename once.
setup: Enable a regex script or extension prompt that injects text when a codename appears.
Use a clear injected marker.
toggles: Regex or extension prompt injection enabled.
expectedSignals: Injected prompt text is present in the assembled payload.
Injected placement is consistent with configured position.
cases.notes: Good for checking pre-LLM post-processing differences.

cases.title: Macro expansion
cases.input: Use the setting that references both names.
setup: Configure prompts that use user, char, and group macros.
Use values that are easy to spot after expansion.
expectedSignals: Expanded macro values appear in final prompt text.
No unresolved macro placeholders remain.
cases.notes: Compare final expanded strings, not source templates.

cases.title: Depth prompt injection
cases.input: Ask a question that should trigger depth prompt handling.
setup: Enable a depth prompt with visible content.

chatSeed.content: We should inspect the lower vault.
What do you expect to find there?

expectedSignals: Depth prompt is inserted at the configured depth position.
Depth prompt order matches itemization when available.
cases.notes: Compares in-chat prompt injection rather than system wrapper prompts.

cases.title: Extension prompt before main
cases.input: Reply while honoring the prepended extension prompt.
setup: Enable an extension prompt at BEFORE_PROMPT with a unique marker.
expectedSignals: Extension prompt lands before the main prompt block.
Marker survives final assembly.
cases.notes: Useful for comparing prompt ordering around main.

cases.title: Extension prompt in chat
cases.input: Trigger the extension prompt that injects into chat history.
setup: Enable an IN_CHAT extension prompt with a unique marker.

chatSeed.content: What did we hide in the cellar?

expectedSignals: Injected message appears in chat history at configured depth or order.
Prompt order is stable across branches.
cases.notes: Checks absolute injection path rather than system prompts.

cases.title: Single tool call history
cases.input: Continue from the last tool result only.
setup: Use a chat with one previous function tool call and a tool result.
expectedSignals: Tool call and tool result are replayed into the payload.
Tool role ordering is preserved.
cases.notes: Compare tool history materialization before dispatch.

cases.title: Multiple tool calls
cases.input: Summarize the tool outputs before replying.
setup: Use a chat with multiple prior tool invocations on one assistant turn.
expectedSignals: Multiple tool results are replayed in stable order.
No tool payload is lost during post-processing.
cases.notes: Tool ordering parity case.

cases.title: Media list attachments
cases.input: Comment on the attached images.
setup: Use a user message with multiple image attachments in list mode.
Pick a model or provider path that supports inline media.
expectedSignals: All list attachments are represented in the dispatch payload where supported.
Attachment ordering is preserved.
cases.notes: Only compare on providers that actually support media in chat payloads.

cases.title: Media gallery selection
cases.input: Comment only on the selected gallery item.
setup: Use a message with gallery media and select a nonzero gallery index.
Pick a media-capable provider.
expectedSignals: Only the selected gallery item is attached inline.
Changing gallery selection changes the payload.
cases.notes: Gallery selection parity case.

cases.title: GPT-5 reasoning effort
cases.input: Solve the puzzle step by step.
setup: Use an OpenAI GPT-5-class model path.
Set a non-default reasoning effort.
expectedSignals: Reasoning effort shaping is preserved in the dispatch payload.
Message content remains otherwise stable.
cases.notes: Compare reasoning_effort or equivalent shaped field.

cases.title: OpenRouter Claude shaping
cases.input: Reply with one concise paragraph.
setup: Use an OpenRouter Claude model.
Enable any configured Claude caching or transforms that the branch supports.
expectedSignals: Claude-specific dispatch shaping is visible.
System and cache-oriented fields match branch behavior.
cases.notes: Provider shaping compare case.

cases.title: o1 request shaping
cases.input: Think carefully before answering.
setup: Use an o1-class model path.
Leave all other settings as default.
expectedSignals: Dispatch payload uses the provider-specific token field that branch expects.
Streaming behavior may differ from baseline.
cases.notes: Checks request-body shaping, not output quality.

cases.title: Claude continue prefill
setup: Use a Claude-family model.
Enable continue prefill.

chatSeed.content: The signal returned at dawn, carrying only three words:

expectedSignals: Assistant prefill content appears in the dispatch payload.
Continue-mode shaping differs from normal mode.
cases.notes: Compare provider-specific continue shaping.

cases.title: World info before
cases.input: Ask about the moonwell.
setup: Enable a lorebook entry keyed on moonwell.
Place the entry before the main prompt.
expectedSignals: Activated entry appears in worldInfo.beforeEntries.
Placement is before prompt and status is admitted.
cases.notes: Core activated-WI compare case.

cases.title: World info after
cases.input: Ask about the observatory cellar.
setup: Enable a lorebook entry keyed on observatory cellar.
Place the entry after the main prompt.
expectedSignals: Activated entry appears in worldInfo.afterEntries.
Placement is after prompt and status is admitted.
cases.notes: Compares after-placement WI insertion.

cases.title: World info at depth
cases.input: Mention the sealed annex.
setup: Enable an at-depth lorebook entry keyed on sealed annex.
Use a visible depth and role.

chatSeed.content: We have not entered the annex in years.

expectedSignals: Activated entry appears in worldInfo.depthEntries.
Depth placement metadata includes depth and role.
cases.notes: Checks depth WI normalization.

cases.title: World info example before
cases.input: Ask for an answer in the showcased style.
setup: Enable a lorebook entry that injects example dialogue before examples.
Use a visible marker in the example content.
expectedSignals: Activated entry appears in worldInfo.exampleEntries.
Placement reflects example-before behavior.
cases.notes: Checks example-message WI placement.

cases.title: World info example after
cases.input: Ask for an answer in the showcased style.
setup: Enable a lorebook entry that injects example dialogue after examples.
Use a visible marker in the example content.
expectedSignals: Activated entry appears in worldInfo.exampleEntries.
Placement reflects example-after behavior.
cases.notes: Second example WI placement case.

cases.title: World info authors note placement
cases.input: Mention the watchman cipher.
setup: Enable one AN-top and one AN-bottom WI entry.
Keep authors note enabled.
expectedSignals: Both entries are activated with distinct placement labels.
Authors note text reflects top and bottom insertion.
cases.notes: Checks placement normalization outside before or after.

cases.title: World info recursion chain
cases.input: Mention the first keyword only.
setup: Enable recursive WI with a known two-step chain.
Keep recursion limit above one.
expectedSignals: Initial entry activates and causes a recursive second activation.
worldInfo.activatedEntries shows both admitted entries.
cases.notes: Compare recursion behavior and ordering.

cases.title: World info probability drop
cases.input: Mention the keyed term once.
setup: Enable a probabilistic WI entry with a visibly low probability.
Repeat the case until the probability path is exercised if needed.
expectedSignals: worldInfo.activatedEntries records a dropped_probability status when the roll fails.
Dropped entry does not appear in final message content.
cases.notes: Compare dropped probability reporting.

cases.title: Forced world info activation
cases.input: Generate after a forced activation is set.
setup: Force-activate a specific lorebook entry that would not key naturally.
Use an unmistakable entry marker.
expectedSignals: Activated entry records an external or forced activation source.
Entry appears even without a natural key match.
cases.notes: Compare forced activation normalization.

cases.title: Hidden lorebook binding
cases.input: Mention the binding keyword.
setup: Enable a hidden or indirectly bound lorebook entry.
Use a visible marker in the entry text.
expectedSignals: Activated entry still appears in normalized worldInfo output.
Branch differences in hidden-book origin remain visible if present.
cases.notes: Fork-only differences should be tagged, not treated as prompt failures.

cases.title: Global world info overflow
cases.input: Mention several keyed concepts in one turn.
setup: Set a small global WI budget.
Enable multiple high-priority entries that all key at once.
expectedSignals: worldInfo.overflowed becomes true.
At least one activated entry records dropped_budget.
cases.notes: Compare overflow flag and dropped budget reasons.

cases.title: Per-lorebook budget overflow
cases.input: Mention several keyed concepts from the same lorebook.
setup: Set a tight fixed or percentage lorebook budget.
Enable multiple entries from the same lorebook.
expectedSignals: worldInfo.activatedEntries records dropped_lorebook_budget.
Other lorebooks can still admit entries if budget allows.
cases.notes: Compares per-book budget handling separately from global overflow.

cases.title: Hide middle message
cases.input: Respond without using the hidden clue.
setup: Create a three-turn conversation where the middle turn contains a lorebook keyword.
mutations: Hide the middle user or assistant message.

chatSeed.content: We passed the moonwell at dusk.
The moonwell was dry and silent.

expectedSignals: Hidden message no longer contributes to chat history.
WI activation may change if the hidden turn held the key.
cases.notes: Primary hide parity case.

cases.title: Hide latest prompt-relevant message
cases.input: Respond after hiding the latest visible clue.
setup: Prepare a chat whose latest visible message includes a strong WI key.

chatSeed.content: The watchman cipher is etched beneath the bell.
Can you decode the watchman cipher?

expectedSignals: Latest hidden turn is omitted from dispatch history.
Activated WI entries can drop relative to the unhidden control run.
cases.notes: Checks hiding close to the generation edge.

cases.title: Unhide message
cases.input: Generate after restoring the message.
setup: Start from a chat where one key-bearing message is already hidden.

chatSeed.content: I thought the ledger stayed in the apse.

expectedSignals: Unhidden content returns to history.
Any WI keyed only by that message can reactivate.
cases.notes: Checks hide-state restoration.

cases.title: Hide, edit, unhide
cases.input: Generate after the hidden message is edited and restored.
setup: Prepare a message whose text changes WI activation when edited.
mutations: Edit the hidden message to replace the key phrase.
expectedSignals: Restored edited content, not the old content, reaches dispatch.
WI activation follows the edited text.
cases.notes: Explicitly covers hide, edit, and unhide sequencing.

cases.title: Edit user message
cases.input: Generate after editing a user turn.
setup: Prepare a user turn with a replaceable keyword.
mutations: Edit an earlier user message before generating.
expectedSignals: Edited user content is reflected in final messages.
WI activation tracks the new user text.
cases.notes: Basic message edit case.

cases.title: Edit assistant message
cases.input: Generate after editing an assistant turn.
setup: Prepare an assistant message with a replaceable keyword.
mutations: Edit an earlier assistant message before generating.
expectedSignals: Edited assistant content is reflected in history.
WI activation tracks the edited assistant text.
cases.notes: Assistant-side edit parity case.

cases.title: Edit narrator or system-style message
cases.input: Generate after editing a narrator-like turn.
setup: Prepare a narrator or system-style message that influences context.
mutations: Edit the narrator-style message before generating.

chatSeed.content: Scene note: the moonwell key is hidden in the rafters.

expectedSignals: Edited narrator content appears in the assembled context if that message class is included.
WI activation follows the edited text when applicable.
cases.notes: Covers nonstandard history roles.

cases.title: Delete middle message
cases.input: Generate after deleting the clue-bearing middle turn.
setup: Create a chat where the middle turn matters for WI or prompt assembly.
mutations: Delete the middle message before generating.

chatSeed.content: The ledger named the sixth arch.
What does the sixth arch imply?

expectedSignals: Deleted message is absent from the final payload.
WI activation changes if the deleted message carried the key.
cases.notes: Primary delete parity case.

cases.title: Delete latest user message
cases.input: Generate after deleting the latest user turn.
setup: Use a chat where the latest user turn changes WI activation.
mutations: Generate from the new latest state.

chatSeed.content: What does the moonwell entry mean?

expectedSignals: Deleted latest user turn is absent from final messages.
History tail and any empty-send behavior may shift.
cases.notes: Checks deletion at the history tail.

cases.title: Delete latest assistant message
cases.input: Generate after removing the previous assistant answer.
setup: Use a chat whose latest assistant turn affects context or continue behavior.
mutations: Delete the latest assistant message before generating.
expectedSignals: Deleted assistant turn disappears from final history.
Promptable tail state changes relative to control.
cases.notes: Assistant-tail deletion case.

cases.title: Default swipe selection
cases.input: Generate using the current default swipe.
setup: Use a message with multiple swipes.
Leave swipe selection at index 0.

swipes: Second swipe mentions the watchman cipher.
Third swipe mentions the sealed annex.

expectedSignals: Selected swipe content is the one that reaches final history.
Inactive swipes do not appear in payload text.
cases.notes: Baseline swipe case.

cases.title: Switch to nonzero swipe
cases.input: Generate after choosing another swipe.
setup: Use a message with at least three swipes.
mutations: Switch the selected swipe from index 0 to index 1 before generating.

swipes: Second swipe mentions the watchman cipher.
Third swipe mentions the sealed annex.

expectedSignals: The newly selected swipe replaces the default text in final history.
WI activation follows the selected swipe content.
cases.notes: Primary swipe selection parity case.

cases.title: Edit selected swipe
cases.input: Generate after editing the selected swipe.
setup: Use a swipe-capable assistant message.
mutations: Edit the selected swipe text before generating.

swipes: Second swipe mentions the watchman cipher.

expectedSignals: Edited swipe text, not the pre-edit text, reaches dispatch.
Current message text stays aligned with selected swipe.
cases.notes: Covers selected-swipe editing semantics.

cases.title: Delete selected swipe
cases.input: Generate after deleting the selected swipe.
setup: Use a swipe-capable assistant message with at least two swipes.
mutations: Delete the selected swipe before generating.

chatSeed.content: Second swipe mentions the watchman cipher.
swipes: Second swipe mentions the watchman cipher.

expectedSignals: Selection moves to the surviving swipe per app behavior.
Final history reflects the post-delete selected swipe.
cases.notes: Checks selected-swipe deletion behavior.

cases.title: Delete non-selected swipe
cases.input: Generate after deleting an inactive swipe.
setup: Use a swipe-capable assistant message with three swipes.
Keep selection on index 0 or 1.
mutations: Delete a non-selected swipe before generating.

swipes: Second swipe mentions the watchman cipher.
Third swipe mentions the sealed annex.

expectedSignals: Final history content does not change if the selected swipe survives.
Snapshot still reflects swipe list mutation only indirectly.
cases.notes: Should be a no-change prompt case if selection does not move.

cases.title: Switch swipe then hide and unhide
cases.input: Generate after restoring the selected swipe message.
setup: Use a swipe-capable message whose swipes key different WI entries.

swipes: Second swipe mentions the watchman cipher.

chatSeed.content: Answer based on the restored line.

expectedSignals: Selected swipe state survives hide and unhide.
Final history reflects the restored selected swipe rather than the default swipe.
cases.notes: Explicitly covers swipe plus hide or unhide interaction.
